column5: Demonstrate the ability to explain core Artificial Intelligence concepts, key terminologies, major application areas, and the role of AI in digital transformation initiatives.
Demonstrate the ability to explain essential Machine Learning paradigms, learning workflows, data requirements, and commonly used evaluation metrics.

column3: Understand Azure AI services and capabilities
column5: Identify and describe core Azure AI services, their primary functions, and typical enterprise use cases.
Analyze problem statements and select suitable Machine Learning models aligned with business and technical requirements.
Evaluate AI scenarios and recommend appropriate Azure AI services to design effective and scalable solutions.
Assess real-world situations and justify the selection of Azure AI services based on constraints, risks, and expected outcomes.
Integrate Responsible AI principles (fairness, reliability, security, privacy, transparency, accountability) into the design and deployment of AI solutions.
Demonstrate readiness to sit for and successfully obtain the Microsoft Azure AI Fundamentals (AI-900) certification.

column3:
In details, after completing the course, trainees will:
1. Fundamental AI Concepts & Azure AI Overview
- Define and distinguish AI, Machine Learning, Deep Learning
- Understand AI workload types: Computer Vision, NLP, Conversational AI, Generative AI
- Master Microsoft's 6 Responsible AI principles
- Identify real-world AI applications in enterprise
- Distinguish Azure AI Services categories and use cases
- Choose appropriate services for scenarios
- Deploy and manage AI services on Azure

2. Machine Learning Fundamentals
- Distinguish Supervised, Unsupervised, and Reinforcement Learning
- Understand ML lifecycle: Data → Training → Evaluation → Deployment
- Apply model evaluation metrics: Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1, RMSE, R²
- Identify and address overfitting, underfitting

3. Computer Vision, NLP, Generative AI Workloads
- Define and distinguish Computer Vision, NLP workloads
- Choose appropriate solutions for real-world problems
- Implement Computer Vision tasks using Azure Vision Services
- Implement NLP tasks using Azure Language Services

4. Responsible AI Principles
- Understand importance of Responsible AI
- Apply Microsoft's 6 Responsible AI principles in projects
- Use Azure tools for fairness, interpretability, transparency
- Identify and mitigate bias in AI models
- Ensure privacy, security, and accountability in AI solutions

5. Certification Readiness
- Master 100% of AI-900 exam content
- Familiarize with exam question formats
- Confidently achieve score ≥700/1000 (passing score)
